name: Danganronpa: Survivor's Guilt
source:
Two years after the end of the Danganronpa TV show, and one year after the events of Danganronpa: LIVe or Die, a huge meetup event for survivors of the various seasons is held. However, someone releases sleeping gas and kidnaps 16 of the attendees to put them in a new killing game on a deserted island. What they don't initially realize is that all of them won their respective seasons by committing murder and getting away with it - so everyone in this game is already a killer!

The protagonist, Rui, is the Ultimate Danganronpa Fan - but will that talent be enough to help him survive Danganronpa for the second time?
translation:
电视剧《弹丸论破》结束两年后，以及《弹丸论破：LIVe or Die》事件一年后，为各季幸存者举办了一场大型聚会活动。然而，有人释放了催眠气体并绑架了16名参与者，让他们在荒岛上参加一场新的杀戮游戏。他们最初没有意识到的是，他们所有人都通过谋杀并逍遥法外赢得了各自的赛季 - 所以这场比赛中的每个人都已经是杀手了！

主角瑞是《弹丸论破》的终极粉丝，但这种天赋足以帮助他第二次在《弹丸论破》中生存下来吗？
